turns.prompt_text: where can I purchase a spool of copper wire
turns.response_html: You can buy spools of copper wire from a variety of retailers, including home improvement stores like Home Depot, electrical supply companies such as Graybar and Steiner Electric Company, and specialty online shops for crafting and jewelry making like Rio Grande and Craftwire USA. For large-scale industrial projects, suppliers like MWS Wire and thyssenkrupp Materials are also available.
